description: Independent hand-derived golden fixtures for Nimphy STEP-007 break-even economics calculation engine.
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC TEST CASES ONLY. Calculated with independent exact rational arithmetic. Not derived from engine execution.

cases.description: Ebook standard $9.99 list price with 2 MB delivery fee and exact integer break-even division
cases.derivation: List price $9.99 at 70% royalty tier yields 699.3 -> rounds to 699 cents under round_half_up. Delivery cost for 2.0 MB at 15 cents/MB = 30 cents. Unit contribution = 699 - 30 = 669 cents ($6.69). Fixed cost $6,690.00 (669,000 cents). Exact division: 669,000 / 669 = 1,000 units with remainder 0. Revenue = 1,000 * 999 = 999,000 cents ($9,990.00).

cases.description: Ebook standard $9.99 list price requiring ceiling due to non-zero remainder
cases.derivation: Unit contribution is 669 cents. Fixed cost is $1,000.00 (100,000 cents). Division: 100,000 / 669 = 149 quotient with remainder 319. Since remainder > 0, ceil(100,000 / 669) = 150 units. Revenue = 150 * 999 = 149,850 cents ($1,498.50).

cases.description: Ebook with zero fixed cost and positive contribution yields zero break-even units
cases.derivation: With zero fixed cost and positive unit contribution (669 cents > 0), zero units are required to cover fixed costs. Revenue is 0 cents.

cases.description: Ebook with +20% cost variance reducing contribution and requiring ceiling
cases.derivation: Gross royalty: 499 * 0.70 = 349.3 -> 349 cents. Base delivery: 1.0 * 15 = 15 cents. Varied delivery: 15 * 1.20 = 18 cents. Unit contribution = 349 - 18 = 331 cents. Fixed cost: $500.00 (50,000 cents). 50,000 / 331 = 151 remainder 19 -> ceil is 152 units. Revenue = 152 * 499 = 75,848 cents ($758.48).

cases.description: Ebook with -20% cost variance increasing contribution
cases.derivation: Gross royalty: 349 cents. Varied delivery: 15 * 0.80 = 12 cents. Unit contribution = 349 - 12 = 337 cents. Fixed cost: 50,000 cents. 50,000 / 337 = 148 remainder 124 -> ceil is 149 units. Revenue = 149 * 499 = 74,351 cents ($743.51).

cases.description: Ebook tier 1 (35%) $1.99 price with 0.5 MB delivery fee requiring component rounding
cases.derivation: Gross royalty: 199 * 0.35 = 69.65 -> 70 cents. Delivery cost: 0.5 * 15 = 7.5 -> 8 cents (round_half_up under per_unit). Contribution = 70 - 8 = 62 cents. Fixed cost: $150.00 (15,000 cents). 15,000 / 62 = 241 remainder 58 -> ceil is 242 units. Revenue = 242 * 199 = 48,158 cents ($481.58).

cases.description: Ebook where gross royalty exactly equals delivery cost yielding zero contribution (unreachable)
cases.derivation: List price $3.00 at tier 2 (70%) gives 210 cents gross royalty. Delivery fee for 14.0 MB at 15 cents/MB is 210 cents. Unit contribution = 210 - 210 = 0 cents. Break-even is unreachable because sales generate zero margin to cover fixed costs.

cases.description: Ebook where delivery cost exceeds gross royalty yielding negative contribution (unreachable)
cases.derivation: Gross royalty: 210 cents. Delivery fee for 15.0 MB at 15 cents/MB: 225 cents. Unit contribution = 210 - 225 = -15 cents. Break-even is unreachable because each sale increases losses.

cases.description: Ebook with zero fixed cost but negative contribution must remain unreachable
cases.derivation: Enforces boundary rule: A zero or negative unit contribution must not be labelled reachable merely because fixed cost is zero. Even with zero fixed cost, negative margin produces net loss on sales.

cases.description: Paperback v1 $15.00 list price with exact integer break-even division
cases.derivation: Royalty: 60% of 1500 = 900 cents. Print cost: 100 base + (200 - 24) * 2 = 100 + 352 = 452 cents. Unit contribution = 900 - 452 = 448 cents ($4.48). Fixed cost: $4,480.00 (448,000 cents). Division: 448,000 / 448 = 1,000 units exact. Revenue = 1,000 * 1500 = 1,500,000 cents ($15,000.00).

cases.description: Paperback v1 $15.00 list price requiring ceiling
cases.derivation: Unit contribution is 448 cents. Fixed cost is $2,500.00 (250,000 cents). 250,000 / 448 = 558 remainder 16 -> ceil is 559 units. Revenue = 559 * 1500 = 838,500 cents ($8,385.00).

cases.description: Paperback v1 with +10% cost variance requiring ceiling
cases.derivation: Base cost: 452 cents. Varied cost: 452 * 1.10 = 497.2 -> 497 cents under round_half_even. Contribution = 900 - 497 = 403 cents. Fixed cost: $2,000.00 (200,000 cents). 200,000 / 403 = 496 remainder 112 -> ceil is 497 units. Revenue = 497 * 1500 = 745,500 cents ($7,455.00).

cases.description: Paperback v1 valid minimum price $5.00 with 300 pages yielding negative contribution
cases.derivation: Royalty: 60% of 500 = 300 cents. Print cost: 100 + (300 - 24) * 2 = 652 cents. Contribution = 300 - 652 = -352 cents (-$3.52). Unreachable because unit margin is negative.

cases.description: Paperback v1 zero fixed cost with negative contribution must remain unreachable
cases.derivation: Zero fixed cost cannot make negative unit contribution reachable.

cases.description: Paperback v2 with zero fixed cost yields zero units
cases.derivation: Zero fixed cost and positive contribution (427 cents) yields 0 units.

cases.description: Hardcover Global EUR 25.00 list price with exact integer break-even division under per_total
cases.derivation: Royalty: 50% of 2500 = 1250 cents. Print cost: 600 base (75 pages <= 75 threshold) = 600 cents. Exact contribution = 1250 - 600 = 650 cents. Fixed cost: €6,500.00 (650,000 cents). Division: 650,000 / 650 = 1,000 units exact. Revenue = 1,000 * 2500 = 2,500,000 cents (€25,000.00).

cases.description: Hardcover Global EUR 29.99 list price with fractional per-unit rational under per_total requiring exact rational ceiling
cases.derivation: Exact royalty: 2999/2 = 1499.5 cents. Print cost: 600 + (200 - 75) * 3 = 975 cents. Exact unit contribution = 1499.5 - 975 = 524.5 = 1049/2 cents. Under per_total, fractional per-unit minor unit is null. Fixed cost: €5,000.00 (500,000 cents). Formula: ceil(500,000 / (1049/2)) = ceil(1,000,000 / 1049) = 953 quotient with remainder 303 -> ceil is 954 units. Revenue = 954 * 2999 = 2,861,046 cents (€28,610.46).

cases.description: Hardcover Global negative contribution under per_total
cases.derivation: Royalty: 50% of 1500 = 750 cents. Print cost: 600 + (500 - 75) * 3 = 1875 cents. Exact unit contribution = 750 - 1875 = -1125 cents (-€11.25). Unreachable because unit margin is negative.

cases.description: Hardcover Global zero fixed cost yields zero units
cases.derivation: Zero fixed cost and positive contribution (650 cents) yields 0 units.
